current_goal.goal: Publish a strictly newer single-truth release only after real AstrBot Dashboard and lifecycle evidence proves that both owned Volcengine model cards expose a real checked-and-persistent Video option and their request fields.
non_goals: Do not create or revive a second installation/publication branch.
Do not accept compile, import, no-conflict, unit-only, or bridge-installed evidence as a substitute for real model-card UI behavior.
Do not make a failed candidate the newest stable version.
Do not leak plugin fields into foreign Provider cards.
Do not send paid Ark requests for a Dashboard/release-topology-only change.

blocking_acceptance: AstrBot 4.27.3 real Dashboard: Ark and Agent Plan create dialogs each show exactly one native Video checkbox; clicking the visible label checks it; save/reopen keeps it checked.
AstrBot 4.27.4 real Dashboard: the same owned-card Video checkbox behavior passes.
AstrBot 4.28.0-beta.1 real redesigned Provider Dashboard: the same owned-card Video checkbox behavior passes.

On every tested host, owned cards visibly expose custom_extra_body plus Video Quality, Thinking Mode, Reasoning Effort, Temperature, Top P, Max Output Tokens, Stop Sequences, Frequency Penalty and Presence Penalty.
Typed request rows can be edited, saved, reopened and retain their values.
Foreign OpenAI/xAI/Gemini cards expose no plugin Video or volcengine_* rows.
The saved Video checkbox survives a real AstrBot process restart and same-version plugin replacement.
Plugin uninstall plus AstrBot restart removes all plugin-owned public UI residue.
The current tree contains no retired second-publication workflow, retired Video fallback implementation, failed-state archive, or branch-specific diagnostic workflow.
The exact final releaseable candidate SHA passes all required GitHub checks before merge.

release_topology.post_release_requirement: Delete stale non-main refs when possible; otherwise collapse them to the exact main release commit so they cannot carry an alternate tree or version.

real_ui_contract.success_definition: observable user-visible model-card state and persistence

stable_boundaries: main is the only installation and version source.
Video is one native modality checkbox on one owned model card, never a source-level or global switch.
Owned model cards retain AstrBot custom_extra_body and the plugin typed request rows.
Foreign provider cards remain free of plugin UI/config fields.
AstrBot owns provider lifecycle, routing, retry and fallback.
The plugin adapts Volcengine protocols without becoming a global model-capability authority.
warning: 0.1.35 is not stable yet. It becomes releaseable only after every blocking real-browser and lifecycle gate passes on the exact candidate SHA.
